en-US.name: MacroPulse Institutional Copilot
en-US.summary: Institutional macroeconomic intelligence, quantitative risk simulations, and volatility breakout alerts on Echo and Fire TV.
en-US.description: MacroPulse bridges hedge fund-grade macro risk management with voice commands and multimodal visual dashboards. Check real-time macro stress regimes (Risk-On / Risk-Off), inspect the 10Y-2Y yield curve and FRED credit spreads, run 10,000-path Monte Carlo VaR simulations, monitor the NVDA Danger Zone index, trigger cross-asset FOMC rate shock tests on your big screen TV, and listen for ambient volatility squeeze chimes.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask MacroPulse for today's market regime
Alexa, show the NVDA Danger Zone on the TV
Alexa, ask MacroPulse to run an FOMC rate shock test
Alexa, ask MacroPulse if there are any volatility squeeze breakouts on SPY

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'Alexa, ask MacroPulse for today's market regime' or 'Alexa, show the NVDA Danger Zone on the TV'.
